verdict.rationale: Consensus documents one bulk operation of its own: the Library can import thousands of papers in one click from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS. There is no evidence of other bulk actions such as bulk tagging, editing, deleting, exporting, or batch API calls on many selected items, so only the import slice of the story is covered. Missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/tag/export operations, batch API/MCP operations over many items, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.
